meta.title: B2B equipment leasing marketplace in Morocco
meta.description: One application, several leasing offers, an informed decision. Free for businesses.

palette.title: Command palette
palette.description: Navigate, change theme or language, sign out.
palette.placeholder: Type a command or a page…

company.name: Business space
company.journeyBody: Four steps, one application: you then compare offers from several lessors on their total cost.

profile.title: Company profile
profile.body: ICE, RC and key details, entered once.

vault.title: Document vault
vault.body: Your documents, encrypted and reusable for every request.

request.title: Financing request
request.body: The equipment, amount and term you need, in under 5 minutes.

compare.title: Compare offers
compare.body: Offers converted to the same format, ranked by total cost.

company.emptyBody: A single request is enough to receive several offers from lessors, free of charge.
company.privacyTitle: Your data stays under your control
company.privacyBody: No document is shared with a lessor without your explicit consent, lessor by lessor (Law 09-08).

lessor.name: Lessor space
lessor.inboxBody: Applications routed to {organization}, sorted by remaining response time.
lessor.emptyBody: Applications matching your risk appetite will appear here, with their response deadline.

admin.name: Back office
admin.overviewBody: State of the platform and its organizations.
admin.kycEmptyBody: Files to verify will appear here once document upload opens.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: The last {limit} events, append-only and chained with SHA-256 digests.
audit.restrictedBody: The audit log is reserved for administrators and operations.

auth.panelTitle: One application. Several offers. An informed decision.
auth.panelBody: Make lessors compete on the total cost of your financing, free of charge.
auth.title: Sign in
auth.subtitle: Access your space.
auth.companyHint: No password: we send you a code or a link valid for 10 minutes.
auth.codeSent: If an account exists for {email}, a code has just been sent.
auth.linkSent: If an account exists for {email}, a sign-in link has just been sent.
auth.proHint: Two-factor authentication is mandatory for lessors and the platform team.
auth.totpPrompt: Enter the 6-digit code shown in your authenticator app.

errors.tooMany: Too many attempts. Try again in a minute.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

twoFactor.title: Turn on two-factor authentication
twoFactor.subtitle: Mandatory for lessors and the platform team before accessing any application.
twoFactor.scanBody: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy…), then enter the code shown.
twoFactor.backupBody: Keep them somewhere safe: each one lets you sign in if you lose your phone. They will not be shown again.

demo.banner: Demo mode: fictitious organizations and people.
demo.title: Demo accounts
demo.intro: Fictitious organizations and people, to showcase the platform. Authentication codes renew every 30 seconds.
demo.passwordless: Sign in with an email code or link
demo.warning: These credentials are public: a demo database never contains real data.
demo.outboxIntro: Sign-in emails land here until an email provider is connected.
demo.outboxEmptyBody: Request a code or a link from the sign-in page.

errors.notFoundBody: This page does not exist or has moved.
errors.forbiddenBody: Your role does not grant access to this space. The attempt has been recorded.

legal.intermediary: {brand} is an intermediary in leasing transactions acting under written mandates from lessors (Law 103-12). {brand} never handles funds and makes no credit decision: the decision belongs exclusively to the lessor.

home.title: Make lessors compete. For free.
home.subtitle: Submit a single application. {brand} checks it and sends it to the right lessors; you compare their offers on total cost.

one.title: One application
one.body: Your documents and request, submitted once and reusable afterwards.

two.title: Several lessors
two.body: With your consent, the application goes to the 3 to 5 lessors whose criteria match.

three.title: An informed decision
three.body: Offers compared on total cost, with no sponsored placement.

emails.magicLinkBody:
Hello,

Here is your sign-in link, valid for 10 minutes:
{url}

If you did not request it, ignore this message.
emails.otpBody:
Hello,

Your sign-in code: {otp}
It is valid for 10 minutes.

If you did not request it, ignore this message.
